name: mageaustralia/maho-module-attribute-manager
description: Bulk dropdown/multiselect option management for Maho. Adds a "Bulk Options" tab to the product-attribute edit page: batch-add options by pasting one value per line, merge options (reassign every product from the ticked options onto a single goal option then delete the merged ones, all on option_id), per-store-view label editing, drag-and-drop reorder, Is Default, and delete. The native option grid is left fully intact.
